description: Use after nis2_gap_assessment when the user wants a plan to close their NIS2 gaps. Turns the same answers into every gap with a recommended action, a priority, the NIS2 article and a 30/60/90-day roadmap (governance, risk and incident gaps first). Requires ClevSec Pro.

answers.description: Question id to answer, e.g. {"g1": "yes", "r2": "partial"}. Omit to get the questions. Unanswered questions count as gaps.

name: nis2_remediation_plan
title: NIS2 remediation plan (ClevSec Pro)
